# netactuate_cloud_kernels (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Kernels visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_kernels" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kernels` (List of Object) Boot kernels available for cloud servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kernels))
